svg.title: 200 trials still do not guarantee a decision
svg.desc: 200 trials still do not guarantee a decision. Probability of each verdict, by exact enumeration. Default Clopper-Pearson · alpha 0.05 · delta 0.10 · K=1 · N per arm · independent arms. One bar per case, drawn to scale: 95% → 65%, N=20: PASS 0.0%, BLOCK 0.8%, INCONCLUSIVE 99.2%. 95% → 65%, N=200: PASS 0.0%, BLOCK 98.5%, INCONCLUSIVE 1.5%. 95% → 75%, N=200: PASS 0.0%, BLOCK 36.5%, INCONCLUSIVE 63.5%. 80% → 80%, N=200: PASS 21.8%, BLOCK 0.0%, INCONCLUSIVE 78.2%. Twenty runs decide almost nothing. False PASS at the margin and false BLOCK under no change are both far below alpha; the price is conservatism. Source: the table under "The gate, measured against itself" in the README.
